name: Ikat
description: Warp-dyed stripes with the feathered edges ikat is known for — the pattern blurs where the yarn shifted in the dye.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(26% 0, 74% 0, 66% 12%, 80% 25%, 62% 38%, 78% 50%, 62% 62%, 80% 75%, 66% 88%, 74% 100%, 26% 100%, 34% 88%, 20% 75%, 38% 62%, 22% 50%, 38% 38%, 20% 25%, 34% 12%); clip-path: polygon(26% 0, 74% 0, 66% 12%, 80% 25%, 62% 38%, 78% 50%, 62% 62%, 80% 75%, 66% 88%, 74% 100%, 26% 100%, 34% 88%, 20% 75%, 38% 62%, 22% 50%, 38% 38%, 20% 25%, 34% 12%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); @random(0.4) { -webkit-transform: scaleX(1.6); transform: scaleX(1.6); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
